text:
tess: quick proposalwe run a 4-week micro-beta for the next design-partner cohort. goal: tighten feedback loops and validate integration intent, not full feature parity.
ali: curious why 4w instead of 6w? tradeoff on signal vs speed.
tess: 4w gives us a faster funnel and lower partner time commitment. hypothesis: clear success gates + good onboarding will produce actionable signals in that window.
mike: what are the proposed success gates? need concrete, measurable things for PM/Eng to act on.
sana: draft gates: onboarding < 45m; 2/3 core flows work end-to-end; partner intent >= 60% (they'd integrate within 3 months); median latency within SLA for 95th pct.
julia: add a quality gate: no more than 15% degraded outputs vs our internal golden-set on critical prompts.
tess: recruitment target: 10 external partners + 3 internal. prefer vertical diversity (saaS search, docs, conversational agents) to spot workload patterns.
ali: incentives? i'd suggest $350 credit + priority support window during the beta. cheaper than stipend, still attractive.
mike: operational ask: eng needs a locked prompt set and a small harness to run 10k tokens/day test traffic for telemetry. who owns prompt curation?
sana: i'll curate the prompt set with input from ali. we'll lock it two weeks before invites.
recruit-bot: reminder: please fill the intake form: https://rwd.internal/dp-intake (auto-reminder in 48h)
julia: feedback cadence: weekly async digest (sheet + short highlight notes) + mid-run 30m sync + final 60m debrief. keep ask minimal: 3 short flows + 15min integration checklist review.
tess: logging matrix to instrument: prompt_id, flow_id, model_variant, latency_ms, token_cost, pass_fail_flag, partner_note. prefer structured tags for repro.
mike: for launch gating: require at least 2 external DPs green + no sev1/2 regressions and a rollback plan. also need a fallback model variant for cost spikes.
ali: rollout plan suggestion: phased rollout by customer segment and traffic percentage (1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%) with canary metric thresholds.
sana: recruitment messaging draft: short blurb highlighting low-friction onboarding, $350 credit, and three focused evaluation steps. i'll post in the doc and ask for copy review.
julia: legal: i'll add data usage language and approval by legal before sends. also mention logs retention policy.
tess: ownership: tess (PM) will own schedule + outreach; sana + ali own prompt set; mike owns eng telemetry and harness; julia handles legal copy.
recruit-bot: note uploaded: /design/dp-microbeta/4278901234-microbeta-spec.md
tess: i'll update the spec today and tag owners. if there are no objections, aim to send invites next Tue.
ali: ack
mike: ack
sana: ack
julia: ack
